req.title: Accept comma-separated status codes
req.statement: The system shall select one code at random when /status/<code> is called with a comma-separated list.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /status/<codes> with a comma-separated list shall select one code at random. The view_status_code handler splits on commas, builds a weighted_choice list, and returns status_code(code). Tests must: (1) verify a valid comma-separated list returns one of the listed codes (positive/EP), (2) verify an invalid code in the list returns 400 (negative/NEG), (3) verify a single-element comma-free path still works correctly (boundary/BVA), (4) verify weighted syntax works (positive/DT), (5) verify all codes in the list are reachable over many trials (mutation-resilient distribution check). Exact status code assertions are used throughout to kill comparison-operator and constant mutations.

tests.name: test_comma_separated_returns_one_of_listed_codes
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Assert response status_code is exactly one of {200, 301, 404}
expected: Response status code is exactly 200, 301, or 404
No other status code is returned
trace: R-HTTPBIN-016: comma-separated list causes random selection from listed codes
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_comma_separated_returns_one_of_listed_codes():
    allowed = {200, 301, 404}
    r = client.get('/status/200,301,404', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code in allowed, f'Got {r.status_code}, expected one of {allowed}'
    assert r.status_code != 500
    assert r.status_code != 400

tests.name: test_comma_separated_all_codes_reachable_over_trials
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Collect all distinct status codes returned
Assert all three codes appear at least once
expected: Over 200 trials, each of 200, 404, 500 appears at least once
trace: R-HTTPBIN-016: random selection must be able to return any listed code
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_comma_separated_all_codes_reachable_over_trials():
    allowed = {200, 404, 500}
    seen = set()
    for _ in range(200):
        r = client.get('/status/200,404,500', follow_redirects=False)
        assert r.status_code in allowed, f'Unexpected code {r.status_code}'
        seen.add(r.status_code)
    assert 200 in seen, 'Code 200 never returned'
    assert 404 in seen, 'Code 404 never returned'
    assert 500 in seen, 'Code 500 never returned'
    assert seen == allowed, f'Unexpected codes seen: {seen - allowed}'

tests.name: test_two_code_comma_list_boundary
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Assert every response is exactly 200 or 500
Assert both 200 and 500 appear at least once
expected: Minimum list size of 2 codes works correctly
Both codes are reachable; no other code returned
trace: R-HTTPBIN-016 boundary: minimum comma-separated list (exactly one comma, two codes)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_two_code_comma_list_boundary():
    allowed = {200, 500}
    seen = set()
    for _ in range(100):
        r = client.get('/status/200,500', follow_redirects=False)
        assert r.status_code in allowed, f'Unexpected {r.status_code}'
        seen.add(r.status_code)
    assert 200 in seen, '200 never returned in 100 trials'
    assert 500 in seen, '500 never returned in 100 trials'
